title: Go Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Print a greeting
examples.description: main is where this Go program starts. fmt.Println prints values on a new line.

examples.title: Name a number
examples.description: The := sign makes a new local variable and chooses its type from the value.

examples.title: Use a clear type
examples.description: A type says what kind of value fits a variable. int stores whole numbers.

examples.title: Choose a path
examples.description: if checks a true-or-false rule. Go uses braces around the steps.

examples.title: Repeat steps
examples.description: A for loop can count from a start value until a test becomes false.

examples.title: Keep a growing list
examples.description: A slice is a view of a list of values. append returns a slice with more items.

examples.title: Visit list values
examples.description: range gives an index and a value for each slice item. _ ignores the index.

examples.title: Look up a key
examples.description: A map links a key to a value. The key below is a name and the value is a count.

examples.title: Use a small function
examples.description: A function can take a number and return a number. This example stores a function in twice.

examples.title: Group related fields
examples.description: A struct groups named fields. Here a book has one title and one page count.

examples.title: Change an original value
examples.description: A pointer stores an address. & gets an address, and * reaches the value there.
examples.code:
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
score := 3
place := &score
*place = 7
fmt.Println(score)
}

examples.title: Pass a value through a channel
examples.description: A channel carries values between parts of a program. A buffered channel can hold one value here.
examples.code:
package main
import "fmt"
func main() {
scores := make(chan int, 1)
scores <- 8
fmt.Println(<-scores)
}
